## Choices (2026-10-11)

- `titleUrl` is the dedicated wiki page
  - `profileUrl` is the Square Enix Wayback page (https://web.archive.org/web/20180911030219/http://www.square-enix.co.jp/magazine/gamebooks/ff/7_turks_tkaa/index.html)

- Description: a short intro, not a summary
